engine_note: Each candidate endpoint was fetched directly and its payload parsed as RSS, Atom, or JSON Feed. Captures are recorded with the number of items actually read; large hot lists were captured partially, which is noted per candidate. Tidings parser rounds were not available in the authoring environment, so this round records HTTP fetch plus feed-parse evidence only.

decisions.title: SoPilot · X 起爆帖监控
decisions.reason: First-party RSS endpoint documented on the product page; channel parses as RSS 2.0.

checks.notes: Product page states 暂无帖子 for the AI board.
Repeat fetch; still an empty channel, feed-level query parameters do not change the payload.
Third fetch roughly two hours after the first two; the channel rebuilt but still lists no posts.

decisions.caveat: Three checks over two hours returned a valid but empty channel because the AI board had no qualifying posts, so the weekly live check reports 'feed has no items' until the board fills again.

decisions.title: NewsNow 最热聚合页
decisions.reason: No public RSS, Atom, or JSON Feed endpoint: the app is a Nuxt front end over /api/s JSON, and /rss falls back to the server-rendered homepage. RSSHub has no newsnow route in master. Its advertised boards are collected individually instead (Zhihu, Weibo, Hupu; V2EX is already in the catalog).

checks.notes: https://newsnow.busiyi.world/rss returned the homepage HTML instead of a feed.
RSSHub master has no lib/routes/newsnow directory, and /newsnow/hottest on the shared instance returns NotFoundError.

decisions.title: REBANG 极简热榜
decisions.reason: Static hot-list pages with no feed: rebang.open2hub.com redirects to top.open2hub.com, and /rss.xml returns the site's 404 page. The boards it mirrors are collected individually instead.

checks.notes: Homepage renders 50+ platform boards as HTML with no alternate feed link.
https://top.open2hub.com/rss.xml returned 非常抱歉，没有找到您要查看的页面.

decisions.title: 萝卜投研
decisions.reason: No public feed and no anonymous access. The submitted address luobo.cn is the 保卫萝卜 game site, not the investment platform; robo.datayes.com answers with a WeChat QR and password login wall, so nothing can be validated or subscribed without credentials.

checks.notes: luobo.cn resolves to 《保卫萝卜4》手游官方预约开启 — a different publisher entirely.
robo.datayes.com returns only the login surface (微信扫码登录 / 密码登录); credentialed feeds are out of scope for this catalog.
